༄༅/ /thub pa'i bstan srung mgon po brgyad kyi sgo nas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i man ngag srog gi spu gri zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// thub pa'i bstan srung mgon po brgyad kyi sgo nas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i man ngag srog gi spu gri zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

/na mo/ bla ma dang yi dam dpal ye shes kyi mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i sgo nas bstan dgra sgrol bar 'dod na/ sa stegs gru bzhi dbus brub khung gru gsum dang ldan pa kha la rtsang dmar nyer gcig gis brgyan pa/ g.yas g.yon gnyis su bya rog 'ug pa'i sgro btsugs pa'i nang du dpe'u ris ltar ra khrag gis ming rus gnas yig bla dwags dang bcas pa bris la/ dug khrag byugs pa'i mthar bsad sngags kyis bskor ba yug skras bcings la/ thun phur dang bcas pa mgor btsugs la brub khung du bcug /steng du gzhung gi gtor ma bzhag |thun thag gtor mar gtad la sne mo rang gis bzung*/ thun gtor/ thun/ phur pa/ gri/ me/ shing*/ g.yag ru rnams nyer bsdogs rdzogs par byas la/ tho rangs las byang tshogs lhag yan chad sngon du btang zhing*/ brub khung bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zangs lcags khro chu las grub pa'i mun khang dgu rim kha khyer yangs shing gting zab pa lha srin sde brgyad 'du zhing gsod gcod kyi las byed pa/ g.yas g.yon du bya rog gdong dang 'ug pa'i gdong gnyis kyis dbye ba'i las byed pa'i mun khang dri mi zhim pa sna tshogs bro ba'i nang du/ thun phur las mgon smug nag phyag gnyis phur pa sgril zhing sku smad phur pa'i dbyibs can dgra bgegs kyi snying la zug pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang*/ mgon po brgyad bdag dang bcas pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas dgra bgegs de nyid skad cig la bkug par gyur/ ces dgug gzhug ci mang byas la drag tu bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ */ bdag cag bla med byang chub sgrub pa dang*| |so thar sdom brtson tshul ltar bsrung ba la// dam nyams byad ma rnams kyi gnod pa byung*// ma hā kā lā mched brgyad mthu bo che// rnal 'byor sgrub po skyong na ra mda' zlog /do nub da dus nam gyi gung thun la// dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung po da lta khug /dgra bgegs gnod byed gzugs phung rdul du rlogs// bla rtags brgyad po gang du rdzu yang rung*// gang brdzus gnyen po ltar du sprul la khug

/da lta bla tshe 'khyam pa'i dus yin gyi// ma shor khug la gzugs ming liṅgar phob// gdong can gnyis kyis lha dang rab phye nas// gshed lnga bdud dang sde brgyad lag tu sprod// bka' yi lha srin dam ldan las mkhan tshogs| |dgra bgegs 'byung po khug sgrol zhal du bzhes// dam rdzas sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la// mnan sreg 'phang sogs drag po'i phrin las rnams// skad cig nyid la 'grub par mdzad du gsol// thun mtshon chad pas dgra bgegs rdul du rlog /ces dus drug tu bskul zhing thun brdeg /bsnyen pa la 'bad/ bskul mjug gtor bsngos bya'o// de ltar bsgrubs pa'i bsad rtags mthar phyin nas liṅga bton la dgug gzhug byas shing*/ thun rdeg /bla gnas gang du gnas sar phur pas phug mthar gris bsgral la rgyas par drag po'i sbyin bsreg bya/ bsdus par skyer pa gru gsum brtsigs/ me sbar zhing me mgon po brgyad du mngon rtogs las byang ltar bskyed nas bsnyen mtshams su bskyal la/ dgug gzhug byas shing bskul ba'i mjug tu rtsa sngags la dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag mgon po brgyad kyi zhal du khā hi dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod rol mo'i sgra dang bcas la 'bul lo// de nas thal sol dang ming yig sbrags la g.yag rur bcug ste mtsho la gtad dam mnan no// de nas nang du 'ongs la gser skyems phul zhing gtor chen dgra phyogs su 'phang ngo*// rim gro srung ba la 'di mi dgos so// zlog bsad dmigs can la 'di mde'u lta bu spu gri'i gnad yin no/ /zhes pa mgon po brgyad kyi sgo nas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las bya ba 'di'ang*/ shākya'i btsun pa chos smra ba rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes chu byi hor zla dgu pa'i nyer gcig la sgar du sbyar ba'o// //shu bhaṃ//
